levels.title: Search heist
levels.mission: Find the target treasure. Every room you enter or compare against raises the alarm.

levels.title: Plant the evidence
levels.mission: Walk the search path for the new key, then confirm the insertion.

levels.title: Cut the guard loose
levels.mission: Name the delete case first, then confirm the removal.

levels.title: Sweep the corridor
levels.mission: Click every key in the range; whole subtrees outside it are pruned for a bonus.

levels.title: Boss: the long chain
levels.mission: Search three checkpoints in a sorted chain. Each checkpoint shrinks the alarm capacity.
